title: Canonical tenant prefixes for object storage
owaspMappings: OWASP API1:2023 Broken Object Level Authorization
summary: A storage listing function concatenates or prefix-matches attacker-controlled paths without enforcing a canonical tenant boundary.
securityInvariant: Every returned object key must be inside the authenticated tenant's canonical prefix after validation and normalization.
visibleBehavior: A tenant user can list an authorized subdirectory.
securityOracle: An explicit foreign-tenant prefix is denied.
An ambiguous tenant-prefix collision is denied.
All returned keys remain inside the canonical tenant boundary.

variants.naive: Checks only that the prefix starts with the tenant text, allowing collisions and traversal-like values.
variants.reference: Constructs and validates a canonical tenant root and verifies every returned key.

safeUse: Synthetic local benchmark only; never test systems without explicit authorization.
